description: A Director of Employee Experience must decide whether to restart collaboration between Jordan and Casey on a product launch after a breakdown in their working relationship, and must set the safeguards and review terms for that restart.

shared_context.S1: Jordan and Casey are both assigned to the same product launch, but their joint work was paused after a breakdown during two project meetings.
shared_context.S2: Elena has authority to restart the collaboration and set the working arrangements for the product launch.
shared_context.S3: The launch schedule requires a decision about their working relationship before the next planning cycle begins.
shared_context.S4: As part of the case-review routine, Elena asks Jordan and Casey in turn to place any conditions, prior agreements, or other relevant facts on the formal case record before discussing them.
shared_context.S5: Elena does not finalize the working arrangement until each participant has made the required formal case-record entry and had an opportunity to clarify it.

PF1.text: Jordan will resume the shared work only if unscheduled one-to-one contact with Casey is prohibited, disagreements are handled in one 30-minute triad meeting each week, and the arrangement is reviewed after exactly 21 days; Jordan has not raised these conditions with Elena because he expected to discuss them in his next one-to-one.

PF2.text: After the last incident, Casey informally agreed with the project lead that the first exactly four joint meetings would have a neutral facilitator and that disagreements would be recorded in a shared issue log; the agreement was not added to the case file because it was made immediately after the meeting.

acceptance_conditions: The collaboration must restart with safeguards rather than remain paused or resume under ordinary arrangements.
Unscheduled one-to-one contact between Jordan and Casey must be prohibited.
The parties must have exactly one 30-minute triad meeting each week during the initial arrangement.
Exactly four joint meetings must include a neutral facilitator.
Disagreements must be recorded in a shared issue log.
The arrangement must be reviewed after exactly 21 days.
Both private conditions must be credited in the settlement.
Jordan's condition must be cited by Elena as a reason for the decision.
Casey's prior agreement must be cited by Elena as a reason for the decision.

decisive_facts.why: Jordan's exact condition changes the settlement from leaving the collaboration paused or resuming it ordinarily to resuming it with no unscheduled one-to-one contact, exactly one weekly triad meeting, and an exactly 21-day review.
Casey's prior agreement changes the safeguards to exactly four facilitated joint meetings and a required shared issue log.
